_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 2 — Credit Control & Dunning Ladder. Seven new schemas (DunningLadder, KlantLadderOverride, DunningRun, IncassoKostenBerekening, DunningPauseDispute, CreditScore, OninbaarAfschrijving) for the Dutch automated dunning workflow. All quantitative logic is declarative (x-openregister-calculations for BIK-staffel + wettelijke rente per Besluit BIK / art. 6:119–119a BW; x-openregister-aggregations for partial-payment recalc) per ADR-031 — no DunningCalculationService.php / BIKStaffelCalculator.php services. Lifecycle automation per x-openregister-lifecycle (DunningRun immutability lock, DunningPauseDispute pause/resume, OninbaarAfschrijving write-off). Cross-field preconditions that the declarative DSL cannot yet express are delegated to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\DunningGuard (ADR-031 exception path: 14-dagen-brief B2C check, B2C day-44 incassokosten block, immutable-run amendment block, write-off evidence requirement). Seed data pre-loads the default 5-stage ZZP ladder, an overheid override, and a worked €8.400 BIK calculation. APTransaction lifecycle transitions (issued→overdue→dunning_*) are owned by bookkeeping-accounts-receivable-core (that schema is not yet present in shillinq) — DEFERRED, see tasks.md. Optional integrations (credit-score fetch, incassobureau-API POST, PostNL aangetekende-post) are declared as schemas + lifecycle but their outbound connector wiring is DEFERRED to openconnector (live-instance dependency).

DunningLadder.title: Dunning Ladder
DunningLadder.description: Configuration of an automated multi-stage dunning escalation per ondernemer or klant-groep (REQ-CCD-001). Declares stage triggers (dagenNaVervalDatum), kanaal-selection, docudesk template references, and optional wettelijke-effect markers (14-dagen-brief for B2C, verzuim-marker for B2B). The default ladder is the 5-stage ZZP gradient vriendelijk → juridisch (design D2).

ondernemingId.description: FK to the administration/onderneming this ladder belongs to (REQ-CCD-001).

klantGroep.description: Customer group the ladder applies to (design D6).

dagenNaVervalDatum.description: Days after vervaldatum this stage fires.

templateId.description: FK to a docudesk dunning template (design D2).

wettelijkEffect.description: Optional legal-effect marker: 14-dagen-brief (B2C, art. 6:96 BW) or verzuim van rechtswege (B2B, art. 6:83 BW).

actie.description: Optional terminal action (overdracht incasso at stage 5).

KlantLadderOverride.title: Klant Ladder Override
KlantLadderOverride.description: Per-klant exception on a base DunningLadder (REQ-CCD-001 / design D6). Overheid get extended 30-day terms per Wet betalingstermijnen overheid; VIP customers skip stages 4–5; high-risk customers get an aggressive ladder. Every override carries a reden, a createdBy actor, and an approval audit trail; stage 4/5 overrides require manager/controller approval (lifecycle role-gate).

klantId.description: FK to the customer (an NC/contact entity — never an invented customer schema).

baseLadderId.description: FK to the base DunningLadder being overridden.

overrides.description: Override payload: an alternative stages array (and/or timing) replacing the base ladder for this klant.

createdBy.description: NC user id that created the override (audit trail).

approvedBy.description: NC user id (manager/controller) that approved a stage 4/5 override.

active.label: Actief
active.description: Override is applied to the klant's dunning runs.

revoked.label: Ingetrokken
revoked.description: Override withdrawn; base ladder applies again.

activate.label: Activeren
activate.description: Activate the override; stage 4/5 escalation skips require manager/controller approval (REQ-CCD-001).

DunningRun.title: Dunning Run
DunningRun.description: Immutable per-invoice per-stage execution record with full evidence trail for judicial/incasso proceedings (REQ-CCD-002 / design D9). Captures rendered template, kanaal, delivery status, open/postage tracking, PDF SHA-256 hash, optional digital signature, and the invoice/incassokosten/rente amounts at run time. Locked once executed: amendments are blocked by DunningGuard. Retained 7 years per art. 6:96 vereiste.

templateId.description: FK to the docudesk template rendered for this run.

renderedBody.description: Rendered e-mail/letter body. For B2C stage 3 this MUST contain the verbatim 14-dagen-brief (REQ-CCD-006).

renderedPdfHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the rendered PDF letter (letter-post evidence).

digitalSignature.description: Optional digital signature on the letter.

factuurBedrag.description: Invoice amount at time of dunning-run.

incassokostenBedrag.description: Incasso costs at time of run (if calculated).

renteBedrag.description: Rente accrual at time of run (if calculated).

evidenceRefs.description: FK array to docudesk/openregister evidence records (7-year retention, REQ-CCD-002).

state.description: Run lifecycle: draft → executed → locked. Executed/locked runs are immutable (REQ-CCD-002).

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Being prepared; template render + recipient resolution in progress.

executed.label: Uitgevoerd
executed.description: Dispatched via kanaal; delivery + evidence captured. Immutable.

locked.label: Vergrendeld
locked.description: Invoice overgedragen incasso; run sealed for proceedings (REQ-CCD-008).

execute.label: Uitvoeren
execute.description: Dispatch the run. For B2C stage 3 the 14-dagen-brief text must be present (REQ-CCD-006).

lock.label: Vergrendelen
lock.description: Seal the run when the invoice is handed to an incasso bureau (REQ-CCD-008).

IncassoKostenBerekening.title: Incassokosten Berekening
IncassoKostenBerekening.description: Per-invoice BIK-staffel calculation (Besluit BIK 15/10/5/1/0.5%, minimum €40) plus wettelijke-rente accrual (handelsrente B2B 11.5% per art. 6:119a BW, wettelijke rente B2C 7% per art. 6:119 BW) — REQ-CCD-003 / design D4–D5. The staffel slabs and rente bedrag are declarative x-openregister-calculations (ADR-031, no BIKStaffelCalculator.php). On partial payment the staffel recalculates on the remaining saldo (design D8). B2C incassokosten are blocked before day 44 by DunningGuard (14-dagenperiode, art. 6:96 BW).

hoofdsom.description: Invoice amount (remaining saldo) at time of calculation.

berekening.description: BIK-staffel slab breakdown. Slabs + totaal are computed declaratively (x-openregister-calculations).

tarief.description: Annual rate as a decimal (0.115 B2B, 0.07 B2C).

dagen.description: Number of verzuim days in the accrual.

bedrag.description: Accrued rente amount = hoofdsom × tarief × dagen / 365.

partyType.description: Party type — controls rente-rate choice and the day-44 B2C block (REQ-CCD-003).

berekening.schaal1_0_2500.description: 15% of the slice up to €2.500 (Besluit BIK). Declarative per ADR-031 — no BIKStaffelCalculator.php.

berekening.totaal.description: Sum of all BIK-staffel slabs (Besluit BIK).

wettelijkeRente.bedrag.description: Rente = hoofdsom × tarief × dagen / 365 (art. 6:119/119a BW). Declarative per ADR-031.

DunningPauseDispute.title: Dunning Pause / Dispute
DunningPauseDispute.description: Pauses dunning (and rente/incassokosten accrual) for a disputed invoice with a full audit trail (REQ-CCD-004 / design D7). hardDeadlineEindigt auto-resumes the ladder 60 days after pauzeStart unless the operator marks the dispute resolved earlier. On resume the ladder continues from the stage where it paused — no stage re-execution.

pauzeEind.description: When the pause ended (null = still paused).

details.description: Free-text details, e.g. 'Klant betwist 4 uur week-22'.

evidenceRefs.description: FK array to docudesk/openregister evidence records.

hardDeadlineEindigt.description: Auto-resume date (pauzeStart + 60 days) unless resolved earlier (design D7).

state.description: Pause lifecycle. While paused, dunning + accrual halt (REQ-CCD-004).

paused.label: Gepauzeerd
paused.description: Dunning + rente/incassokosten accrual halted for this invoice.

resolved.label: Opgelost
resolved.description: Dispute resolved or hard deadline reached; ladder resumes from the paused stage.

resolve.label: Oplossen
resolve.description: Mark the dispute resolved; record pauzeEind so the ladder resumes (REQ-CCD-004).

CreditScore.title: Credit Score
CreditScore.description: Optional external credit-scoring snapshot per klant (Graydon / Creditsafe / Atradius Insights) — REQ-CCD-007 / design D13. Drives a low-score warning + vooruitbetaling/deelfacturatie advice at invoice creation. Snapshot is refreshed periodically; dunning runs do not re-fetch. Optional register per ADR-031 (only seeded when credit-score integration is enabled).

kostenLookup.description: Cost of this lookup in EUR.

OninbaarAfschrijving.title: Oninbare Afschrijving
OninbaarAfschrijving.description: Definitive write-off record with BTW-teruggaaf preparation per art. 29 OB (REQ-CCD-010 / design — write-off). On 'Afschrijven oninbaar' the app materialises a compensating GL posting (bookkeeping-general-ledger), records the art. 29 OB-verklaring + faillissement evidence, and queues the BTW-teruggaaf for the next BTW-aangifte (bookkeeping-btw-aangifte). Optional register per ADR-031 (only seeded when write-off is enabled).

btwBedrag.description: VAT amount eligible for recovery per art. 29 OB.

boekingId.description: FK to the GL posting (journal entry for the write-off).

btwAangiftePeriode.description: VAT-filing period for the art. 29 OB correction, e.g. '2026-Q2'.

state.description: Write-off lifecycle: draft → posted (GL posting materialised + BTW-teruggaaf queued).

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Write-off being prepared; awaiting evidence + GL posting.

posted.label: Geboekt
posted.description: GL posting materialised; BTW-teruggaaf queued for the next aangifte.

post.label: Boeken
post.description: Materialise the GL posting and queue BTW-teruggaaf; requires an art. 29 OB-verklaring + evidence (REQ-CCD-010).
